messages:
sasha: Quick rollout plan for the AWQ-int8 / fp8 bakeoff winners — need alignment on canary waves, warmup, and fallback rules. TL;DR: AWQ-int8: ~0.9% accuracy delta on our conv golden set, latency +12% p95 vs fp16, unit cost -38%. Planning to deploy across hosted -> dedicated -> private.

sasha: Proposed wave matrix (sketch):
```
wave1: hosted canary 1% traffic, 30m watch, golden delta gate <= 1.2%, latency p95 <= 150ms
wave2: hosted 10% traffic, 2h watch, gated by rolling evals & error-rate
wave3: dedicated reserved pool 10% (traffic corridor), 6h, run long-tail regressions + sample mix tests
wave4: private (customer sandboxes) opt-in 5%/customer, ramp after acceptance
fallback: immediate divert to fp16 variant if regression > 1.5% OR error-rate > 0.5% OR infra OOMs
warmup: preheat KV cache for top routes + 10 minute traffic ramp per wave
```

mike: Quick q — KV cache warmup could spike p95 for first few minutes. Recommend preheat + synthetic requests to top 50 routes. Also set auto-backoff at 5% error spike. :eyes:

sasha: Agreed. Add: synthetic preheat job (existing preheat lambda) + 10m zero-ramp then linear ramp to target weight over 10m. We'll also track per-route cache hit rate.

anna: For the golden-set gate, can we be explicit on metrics? I suggest: accuracy_delta_mean <= 1.0% and no more than 10 samples with >5% regression. Also check hallucination rate with the safety evals.

quant-bot: Bakeoff summary (automated): AWQ-int8 vs fp16 on conv-golden (n=5k): mean accuracy delta = 0.92%, std = 0.18%. Latency p50/p95 = +7%/+12%. Cost delta = -38%. Regression clusters: slot-filling examples show largest deltas.

li: Curious about dedicated GPUs — does AWQ-int8 use different kernel path that impacts memory for KV? If yes, need to validate reserved pool sizing.

sasha: Yes — AWQ path uses smaller activation precision but larger temporary buffer during attention compilation. Preliminary mem profile: +6% peak GPU mem. We'll increase reserved pool by 1 GPU per 20 nodes for the first stage.

nina: SRE notes: add circuit-breaker: if deployed cluster error-rate > 0.4% for 5m OR latency p95 > 200ms for 5m, auto-divert 100% to fallback and page on-call. Also we should enable per-region fallback; don't have global failover without ops approval.

mike: For private customers, we need an opt-out flag and a rollback playbook in the console. Also confirm that Private deployments honor the same fallback policy or require customer consent.

jamie: I'll draft the console UX: toggle for "Enable quant variant auto-fallback" + show recent golden-set trends + button to force rollback. UX will also show warmup progress and preheat status.

sasha: Ops checklist for rollout (short):
- confirm golden-set threshold (anna)
- preheat job + synthetic traffic (mike)
- reserve extra GPU capacity for dedicated (li)
- circuit-breaker + per-region failover (nina)
- private opt-in policy + customer comms (jamie)
- telemetry: token-level cost, per-route latency, golden-set evals each wave

quant-bot: Also: recommend a 24h observation window after wave3 for long-tail regressions. If new clusters show >0.8% mean delta on extended evals, trigger rollback.

anna: I'm ok with those numbers if we add an escalation path: if regression is borderline (1.0-1.5%), run a rapid A/B with manual inspection by ML leads before auto-fallback.

sasha: Sounds good. One more: can we make the fallback policy policy-driven (config JSON) so Dedicated/Private can tweak thresholds? Sample config: 
```json
{"gate":{"mean_accuracy_delta":1.2,"max_sample_regressions":10,"error_rate":0.005},"fallback":"fp16","warmup_minutes":10}
```

li: +1 to config-driven approach. We'll add validation checks at deploy-time to ensure Private customers don't accidentally opt into auto-fallback without review.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: 2026-03-21T02:00Z -> Canary wave1 (hosted) 1% traffic. CI: green. :rocket:

jamie: I'll send a short runbook + Slack snippet for on-call and customer success before we flip wave1. Anyone opposed to starting tomorrow?

mike: No objections from infra side. I'll own preheat job and traffic ramp automation. :thumbsup:

nina: SRE ready for circuit-breaker config and alerts. On-call will be paged if auto-divert triggers.

sasha: Awesome — I'll publish the rollout config into the repo and add the golden-set eval dashboard. Thanks all.

jamie: I'll follow up with copy for CS and a short note to the private customers on the opt-in flow.

sasha: Closing — will post PR link once config is up. :white_check_mark:
